entries.subtitle: Demiholumn and Natalia's outside ally
entries.text: Lester: Motivations Demiholumn and Natalia's outside ally Help Natalia when ordinary methods fail while preserving the autonomy and secrecy of a life the hidden authorities may refuse to recognize. Lester

entries.title: Lester: Nature
entries.subtitle: Demiholumn and Natalia's outside ally
entries.text: Lester: Nature Demiholumn and Natalia's outside ally Classification Demiholumn Lester is half human and half Holumn. This is an inherent condition, not magecraft, a profession, or membership in Natalia's business. Known consequence The impossible becomes possible His part-Holumn nature sometimes allows him to accomplish things Natalia could not obtain through ordinary investigation or Magus practice. Unresolved boundary Human agency inside a Holumn nature How the two halves coexist, what they permit, and what they cost Lester have not yet been defined. Lester

entries.title: Lester: Strengths and weaknesses
entries.subtitle: Demiholumn and Natalia's outside ally
entries.text: Lester: Strengths and weaknesses Demiholumn and Natalia's outside ally Lester seeks stimulation, novelty, conflict, and direct engagement with whatever stands in front of him. His appetite for immediate experience gives Natalia an ally willing to enter situations that scholarship alone cannot reach. His exact capabilities, origin, and inner experience remain unresolved. Impossible intervention His part-Holumn nature can make an otherwise impossible task achievable for Natalia, although the mechanism and limits remain unknown. Outside ally He assists Natalia without joining her business. Natalia remains the sole employee of her office. Unclassified existence Neither the human nor Holumn half currently explains the whole person, leaving his place in the hidden world uncertain. ESTP strong Se Confirmed Lester

entries.title: Lynleit: Biography
entries.subtitle: Fionn's biological daughter and displaced heir
entries.text: Lynleit: Biography Fionn's biological daughter and displaced heir Lynleit grew up close to MSF leadership. Felix and Reiner became her friends and the bodyguards Fionn trusted with her safety. At the Magi Academy, Natalia was her favourite teacher. She distrusted Helena before any open conspiracy, noticing her stepmother's questions about Fionn's schedules, visitors, trusted officers, and Lynleit's travel. During Kyrien's failed attack on an MSF-protected politician, Lynleit was nearly harmed. He never learns that she was there. She later questions him and uses an extraordinary transfer clause in MSF's government contract to recruit him secretly, telling only Felix and Reiner. After her mother's death, Lynleit resisted the family's move from Turon to Vilen and accepted it only on the condition that her study-bedroom occupy the third floor. The hillside site places thick trees close to the house and overlooks a river flowing toward the city center. Rustling leaves inspire her. She regards flowing water as life energy and seeks its emotional grounding despite her childhood fear of drowning. Days before Fionn's death, the Nameless Street leaves Lynleit with the memory of a dead boy below a broken fence. Seeing her father's body below the hill at the family house brings the memory back. Helena uses her stunned reaction to support the accusation that Lynleit killed him. Hunted and out of resources, Lynleit reaches Kyrien's hotel-room hideout. He helps her reconnect with Felix and Reiner. Fionn's old officers begin questioning Helena when Lynleit can answer his private recognition challenge and Helena cannot. During the river operation, the Drowned Choir drags Lynleit underwater and tears away her blue suede jacket. She burns the hands with blue flame, breaks the surface, and stands on the water. Kyrien sees her from the park bank and keeps her secret. Father Mikhail later discovers that Kyrien, Felix, and Reiner know about magic. Lynleit insists on handling the breach herself. When the Church and Magiarchy send her to assist Mikhail in Cardiff, she sends Kyrien to help Myka at the Academy. She underestimates the danger there. In Cardiff, she and Mikhail protect one another despite their incompatible methods. Midway through Arc 1, after Fionn's death, Lynleit discovers that he replaced her coat with a leviathan-hide garment. Near the end of the arc, she and Kyrien survive a shared curse after an incomplete attempt at intimacy. She refuses to discuss it with him even after the curse is gone. Their sexual relationship begins later. Near the Arc 2 transition she disappears, remaining away to raise their son, recover, and seek answers about the Spill. Years later she begins appearing around MSF missions without explaining her return. Grows up as Fionn's daughter and studies magecraft under Natalia. Survives the Drowned Choir; Kyrien witnesses her walking on water. Assists Mikhail abroad without MSF's conventional resources. Sends Kyrien to help Myka while she is away. Helena blames her for Fionn's death. Escapes to Kyrien and reconnects with Felix and Reiner. Asks Kyrien why he keeps accepting danger without a promised reward. Survives a shared curse after an incomplete attempt at intimacy. Leaves near the Arc 2 transition to raise her son and investigate the Spill. Reappears around MSF operations without announcing her return. Lynleit

entries.title: Lynleit: Conflicts
entries.subtitle: Fionn's biological daughter and displaced heir
entries.text: Lynleit: Conflicts Fionn's biological daughter and displaced heir Helena's accusation She must recover allies inside the agency now hunting her. Forbidden witnesses Mikhail knows she disclosed magic to Kyrien, Felix, and Reiner. She insists on handling the breach herself. Lynleit

entries.title: Lynleit: Connections
entries.subtitle: Fionn's biological daughter and displaced heir
entries.text: Lynleit: Connections Fionn's biological daughter and displaced heir Natalia Favourite teacher and friend Lynleit jokes with Natalia, challenges her conclusions, and readily returns to her for help. She follows her explanations with a student's curiosity rather than a subordinate's deference. Natalia taught her at the Magi Academy, later asks her to help Myka, and identifies ego transformation as a possible way to survive the shared curse. Father Mikhail Cardiff counterpart and theological adviser The Magiarchy and Church send Lynleit to assist Mikhail abroad. They protect one another despite a moral rift, and he later confirms through Church records that the shared curse can be broken through genuine identity transformation. Kyrien Kyrien's failed attack nearly harms her, but she never tells him. Their coerced alliance acquires a private familiarity through card games and shared work. He keeps her water-walking secret, shelters her after Fionn's murder, and chooses to stay when he could leave. An incomplete attempt at intimacy ends their shared curse; her embarrassment and his unanswered questions outlast it. Helena Lynleit distrusts her stepmother before the takeover, then learns Helena played a major role in Fionn's assassination even though the full conspiracy remains unclear. Potential sexual tension Kyrien Established arc Mutual, slow to surface Lynleit studies Kyrien first as a recruit whose failed attack nearly harmed her. Their card games make that scrutiny personal: she learns his tells and begins noticing his hands and breath. Later she attempts intimacy as a possible treatment for their shared curse, but remains interested after they survive without completing it. The interrogation, card games, protected secret, and voluntary decision to stay give this pairing different kinds of familiarity. In Doom Has an Address, an incomplete attempt at intimacy breaks the shared curse. Lynleit loses the excuse of treatment without losing her interest in Kyrien; he is left trying to understand what happened. Their sexual relationship begins later in Arc 1. Potential sexual tension Felix Established asymmetry Felix overt, Lynleit deflecting Felix's flirting belongs to a long friendship she refuses to reorganize around his advances. Her ease with him, combined with the repeated refusal, creates visible chemistry without requiring matching sexual intent. The tension is easy for readers to recognize because it already has a social rhythm: he advances through jokes and flirtation, she ignores or redirects him, and neither abandons the closeness underneath the exchange. It does not need to become a relationship to remain real. Lynleit

A rightward cant lets her draw with her right hand. The pistol's small proportions and the long jackets or coats central to her wardrobe keep it concealed without disturbing her usual silhouette. weapons.html#ren-l17-sparrow Later loan Ren L21 "Rook" 9×19 mm Borrowed from Felix Micro-compact Felix later lends Lynleit his personal L21 after her continued preference for the weaker 9×17 Sparrow becomes a cause of concern for him. The coat chooses whether to appear as a coat, scarf, an imitation of her lost suede jacket, or another piece of clothing. Its protection does not activate merely because she wears it. entries.title: Lynleit: Magecraft
entries.subtitle: Fionn's biological daughter and displaced heir
entries.text: Lynleit: Magecraft Fionn's biological daughter and displaced heir Hereditary magecraft Blue flame Lynleit inherited her family's ability to manifest blue flame. It can be directed into many applications, but her control is less subtle than Fionn's. Natural tendency Unsafe volume Where Fionn relies on virtuosity and precision, Lynleit has the nerve to call forth far more flame than is safe. Force comes more readily to her than finesse. Irreplaceable force Beyond ordinary weapons Blue flame becomes indispensable when normal firearms cannot finish the threat: an immortal or rapidly regenerating Holumn, a body that moves without being alive, or a barrier that conventional force cannot breach. Accidental miracle-making Walking on water This ability appeared independently of her inherited magecraft. It manifested from her childhood fear of drowning and allows her to cross the surface of water on foot. Its resemblance to a sacred miracle places it outside tolerated magecraft. Strictly concealed Night practice Lynleit keeps the talent secret from everyone because the Church strongly punishes miracle-making that imitates acts associated with Jesus, saints, saviours, and other sacred figures, even when the effect seems harmless. She practices alone at night on secluded stretches of local lakes and rivers. Lynleit

entries.text: Lynleit: Strengths and weaknesses Fionn's biological daughter and displaced heir Lynleit puts MSF and her personal missions first. She plans ahead, notices shifts in people's loyalties, and usually shares enough of her thinking for others to act with her. In private she is reserved and reflective. Personal embarrassment can make her evasive or irritable, especially when Kyrien notices more than she meant to reveal. Relational leadership 95 Her first instinct in crisis is to read trust, morale, legitimacy, shared burden, and the emotional field around her. She treats candid communication as a practical source of trust and coordinated action. Strategic foresight 92 Her unusually strong intuition identifies long-range patterns and what events are becoming before most people can name the change. Private introspection 86 In private she is comfortable disappearing into solitude, following symbolic threads, and processing difficult emotion internally. ENFJ strong Ni Confirmed Lynleit

entries.text: Myka: Biography Magi Academy student Myka studies at the Magi Academy and keeps in regular contact with her aunt Natalia, a former professor. Myka encounters terrors inside the Academy and must rely on Natalia for rescue and support. Natalia asks Lynleit for help, but Lynleit is being sent to Cardiff and dispatches Kyrien as her substitute. The threat turns formal study into a struggle for survival inside an institution meant to train and protect young Magi. Kyrien enters the Academy as a non-Magus undercover helper and keeps Myka safe through conventional field skills and communications with Felix and Reiner. The danger exceeds Lynleit's estimate and forces Natalia to intervene personally. This becomes Myka's first direct experience with Kyrien and MSF. Myka survives the Academy crisis and graduates at the top of her class. Her experience with Kyrien contributes to her later decision to join MSF as a Magus. entries.title: Natalia: Biography
entries.subtitle: Independent magical examiner and private investigator
entries.text: Natalia: Biography Independent magical examiner and private investigator Natalia earned a professorship at the Magi Academy as a talented Magus and serious researcher. Lynleit became her favourite student during those years. Natalia eventually found academic life too constraining: the institution could support scholarship, but it also defined which questions were respectable and how far an inquiry was permitted to go. She resigned to continue her work independently. Natalia opens a private-investigation business to pay for her independent research. Her knowledge of Magi and magecraft attracts clients whose problems ordinary investigators cannot handle. Her one-woman office now sits between a detective agency, consultation room, and private laboratory. Clients bring suspected crimes, unstable talents, personal deviations, and magical problems they cannot safely expose. Natalia examines the person and phenomenon before deciding whether a crime has occurred at all. Lester repeatedly forces her to distinguish professional fascination with his demiholumn condition from personal attention to him. When Myka encounters terrors inside the Academy, Natalia becomes her principal source of advice, rescue, and support beyond the institution. She asks her former student Lynleit for help, then intervenes personally when the danger exceeds the protection Kyrien can provide. Natalia's work repeatedly brings her into contact with Lester. Her interest in him becomes personal as well as professional. Helping Myka renews her work with Lynleit and introduces her niece to Kyrien and MSF. Teaches Lynleit at the Magi Academy. Resigns to pursue research independently. Takes investigative and examination work to fund it. Intervenes when Kyrien can no longer contain the danger to Myka. Identifies transformation as an alternative to the shared curse's fatal solution. Works with Lester as an independent ally. Natalia

entries.text: Natalia: Connections Independent magical examiner and private investigator Lester Outside ally and source of tension Lester remains outside the business, but his demiholumn nature sometimes carries Natalia past barriers that scholarship and ordinary investigation cannot cross. Their attraction develops along the boundary between examination and being personally seen. Myka Niece, student, and friend Natalia keeps constant contact with her niece at the Magi Academy. Myka asks for advice on her studies, Natalia checks on her life, and their bond often resembles mother and daughter as much as aunt and niece. Lynleit Former favourite student and friend Natalia teaches through examples Lynleit can work through, including her own failed approaches. Lynleit teases her, offers playful objections, and trusts her enough to keep asking difficult questions. Their friendship is informal; Natalia's greater experience remains evident in the corrections and connections Lynleit learns from her. They work together over Myka's danger and the curse Lynleit shares with Kyrien. Lester Lester is not her employee. He is an outside ally and a demiholumn whose part-Holumn nature sometimes allows him to accomplish what should be impossible for an ordinary investigator. Their repeated work carries sexual tension because her effort to understand him cannot remain entirely separate from personal attention. Institutional capture The Academy, Magiarchy, and Church can each narrow an inquiry by deciding which questions are permissible, which cases belong to them, and which answers must remain hidden. Potential sexual tension Lester Established tension Mutual, differently expressed Lester is the living exception that Natalia cannot finish classifying. Her professional attention can become personal before she recognizes the change, especially when he interrupts an examination by noticing that she is watching him rather than the phenomenon around him. Repeated cases bring Natalia's examination of Lester into conflict with his insistence on being treated as more than a case. He provokes her to act; she notices more than he expected. Their attraction does not answer her questions about his demiholumn nature. Natalia

entries.title: Natalia: Strengths and weaknesses
entries.subtitle: Independent magical examiner and private investigator
entries.text: Natalia: Strengths and weaknesses Independent magical examiner and private investigator Natalia is a researcher first and a private investigator by necessity. She protects her intellectual autonomy and studies unusual systems without needing institutional agreement. She explains difficult ideas through worked examples and experiences from her own research, including failed approaches and corrections. She asks the listener to try the next step, admits what she cannot establish, and enjoys a good objection. With Lynleit, the lesson includes familiar teasing and the easy affection of a teacher and former student who remain friends. Independent scholarship She resigned from the Academy when its environment became too restrictive for the questions and methods she wanted to pursue. Magical examination She investigates people as readily as incidents, studying unusual magecraft, personal deviations, and conditions with a precision closer to a physician than a conventional detective. Selective casework The business has one employee: Natalia. Paid cases finance her research and let her choose which clients, risks, and secrets enter her office. Identity analysis When Lynleit and Kyrien inherit a shared curse, Natalia introduces the ego hypothesis and quotes Jung. A two-name diagram helps Lynleit follow its paired attachment; Natalia's own research mistakes distinguish a changed self-description from a change in decisions. She cannot measure the degree of transformation the curse requires. INTP strong Ti Confirmed Natalia

After Fionn's murder and the hunt for Lynleit's arrest, Kyrien helps her contact Reiner and Felix from hiding. Reiner must protect her, preserve the covert link inside Helena's MSF, and decide how far disciplined loyalty can support the effort to reclaim the agency. entries.title: Sherie: Biography
entries.subtitle: Diplomat in training and covert negotiator
entries.text: Sherie: Biography Diplomat in training and covert negotiator Sherie studies diplomacy under her uncle Drake. She is quicker at reading a room and drawing people into conversation than he is. Drake's peers ridicule his warning and the Duke remains skeptical. Sherie believes her uncle, but rejects his decision to remain inside official limits and begins designing her own approach to Lynleit. Sherie develops the unauthorized approach to Lynleit against Drake's wishes, persuades him to attend, and leads the negotiations herself. After it succeeds, she asks him to praise and pamper her. Sherie and Drake use the private agreement to ask Lynleit for a loyal team capable of covertly inspecting apparently unmanned night shipments on the Vilen river. The empty boats and the Drowned Choir prove that the suspected coup cannot be understood as a purely political operation. Trains under her uncle Drake. Proposes approaching Lynleit outside official channels. Conducts the hilltop negotiation despite Drake's reluctance. Requests the river inspection with Drake. Sherie

entries.title: Sherie: Connections

entries.text: Sherie: Connections Diplomat in training and covert negotiator Drake Her uncle, mentor, and strategic counterpart. He trains her for diplomacy, while her charm and quick mind carry them through situations his social skills cannot. Official oversight The government and Ducal Court would end the partnership if either discovered it. Potential sexual tension Kyrien Strong potential Situational and confrontational Kyrien's refusal to be steered threatens a skill she has internalized as part of her identity. Each failed attempt to produce a reaction can make his eventual attention feel more valuable and personally dangerous. Sherie uses language and calibrated flirtation to control the rhythm of an exchange. Kyrien answers with silence, literalism, or no usable reaction at all. Repeated negotiation could turn her professional frustration into sexual tension without making them compatible or displacing Kyrien's eventual relationship with Lynleit. Potential sexual tension Felix Emerging potential Mutual play, sincerity unresolved Felix gives Sherie immediate wit, visible attention, and resistance that does not become hostility. She first tests him as play and competition, including whether his attention can be drawn away from Lynleit. The tension becomes personal when winning ceases to satisfy her and she begins wanting a response that is not produced by technique. Both use social ease as protection: Felix hides seriousness behind jokes, while Sherie hides vulnerability behind charm and diplomacy. Their chemistry is immediate, but similarity makes them capable of prolonged flirtation without honest movement. Sherie begins testing the friendship after learning that Lynleit has slept with Kyrien while still feeling responsible for Felix's affection. Her refusal to treat Felix as Lynleit's permanent responsibility creates a comic rivalry with Lynleit and a more serious test of whether Sherie wants Felix himself or only wants to win his attention. Sherie

entries.title: Yulia: Biography
entries.subtitle: Criminology student and procedural investigator
entries.text: Yulia: Biography Criminology student and procedural investigator Yulia and Hiyu study criminology at the same university. She stands at the top of the class through discipline, detail, and command of established method, while Hiyu makes his reputation through personal investigations that ignore the path everyone else was taught to follow. Their interaction is often painful to observe: he chases another possibility, she develops another headache, and neither notices how accustomed they are becoming to the other's company. Hiyu concludes that magic may be involved in the park disappearances despite not knowing that magic actually exists. Yulia considers the theory absurd, but joins his attempt to enter the quarantine partly to prove him wrong and partly because she does not trust him to remain safe alone. Inside the park, Yulia's meticulous observation remains valuable, but ordinary criminological protocol cannot tell her what rules the environment follows. Her attachment to Hiyu becomes a second vulnerability because protecting him can pull her deeper into a danger neither of them understands. Their original aversion gradually becomes dependence and then unacknowledged romantic tension. Yulia refuses to name it, while Hiyu remains so absorbed in ideas that he does not understand why her company has become necessary to him. Excels at criminology through careful method. Accompanies Hiyu to challenge his theory and keep him safe. Encounters events her training cannot explain. Becomes increasingly attached to Hiyu despite their disagreements. Yulia

entries.title: Yulia: Conflicts

entries.title: Yulia: Connections
entries.subtitle: Criminology student and procedural investigator
entries.text: Yulia: Connections Criminology student and procedural investigator Hiyu Her opposite in method and temperament. He generates possibilities she would never entertain, while she gives his ideas evidentiary discipline. Over time, irritation becomes an attachment neither understands clearly. An investigation without rules Yulia can master a known procedure, but the park confronts her with evidence whose governing categories have not yet been admitted to exist. Potential sexual tension Hiyu Emerging arc Mutual, unequally conscious Hiyu irritates her into sustained attention. She keeps arguing, correcting, and following because his ideas have already occupied more of her mind than she wants to admit. Suppressed attraction can sharpen both her impatience and her awareness of his physical presence. Their arguments repeatedly force proximity and attention. They lean over the same evidence, reach for the same document, and forget ordinary distance while trying to prove incompatible explanations. Yulia notices first and steps away; Hiyu continues the theory and wonders why she moved. Her anger becomes disproportionate when his recklessness makes the possibility of losing him real. Hiyu recognizes the bond through absence: an investigation without her corrections becomes less interesting, and he keeps turning toward the place where she should be. Yulia and Hiyu become intimate by learning to communicate through the noise they already create together. Yulia

entries.title: Yulia: Motivations
entries.subtitle: Criminology student and procedural investigator
entries.text: Yulia: Motivations Criminology student and procedural investigator Keep Hiyu alive, test his impossible theory honestly, and preserve enough reliable evidence to understand what ordinary criminology cannot explain. Yulia

entries.title: Yulia: Strengths and weaknesses
entries.subtitle: Criminology student and procedural investigator
entries.text: Yulia: Strengths and weaknesses Criminology student and procedural investigator Yulia is methodical, detail-oriented, reliable, and most comfortable when evidence can be tested against a stable procedure. Hiyu's constant eureka moments and improvised logic give her a headache, but she repeatedly follows him anyway. Their opposition works because she checks what he leaps toward, while he forces her to consider possibilities no established protocol would admit. Procedural rigor She is at the top of her criminology class because she applies method consistently, respects chains of evidence, and notices when a required step has been skipped. Detail verification Yulia is strongest when a theory must be tested against the record, an observation must be preserved accurately, or an exciting conclusion must survive patient scrutiny. Reluctant loyalty She complains, resists, and wishes she were elsewhere, yet still goes with Hiyu when leaving him alone would place him in greater danger. ISTJ strong Si Confirmed Yulia

entries.title: Yulia: Tradecraft
entries.subtitle: Criminology student and procedural investigator
entries.text: Yulia: Tradecraft Criminology student and procedural investigator Academic strength Classical criminological method Yulia follows evidence handling, observation, reconstruction, and procedural discipline with a consistency Hiyu does not naturally possess. Team function Verification and correction She tests Hiyu's intuitive threads, separates useful anomalies from noise, and gives their investigations a record another person could actually follow. Failure condition Procedure without precedent The quarantined park is especially dangerous because its supernatural conditions do not respect the categories or safety assumptions on which her strongest methods depend. Yulia

entries.title: Character Behaviour Audit · v1
entries.subtitle: Writer's Character Reference
entries.text: Character Behaviour Audit · v1 Writer's Character Reference Advisory scene notes combining established characterization, physical circumstance, sex, social experience, and MBTI function emphasis without turning broad gender patterns into canon. Character Behaviour Audit This writer-facing record tests whether a reaction feels specific to the character who performs it. The notes combine established history, physical circumstances, sex, social expectations, and MBTI function emphasis. They are possibilities for the author to accept, reject, or revise. They are not canon until they enter a story record. How the audit works Begin with what the character already wants, fears, notices, and knows how to do. Use sex and social experience where the scene makes them materially relevant: physical leverage, clothing, public danger, expectations learned in childhood, or the way another person reads the character. Use MBTI functions to shape attention and decision-making. They do not excuse an action or predetermine it. A useful note creates a more precise choice. A broad claim that any man or woman would behave the same way should be discarded. Story-pressure notes identify a possible payoff or image. They remain separate from confirmed scene facts. river-operation The river operation nameless-street The Nameless Street relationships-under-pressure Relationships under pressure long-term-inheritance Long-term inheritance academy-crisis The Academy crisis cardiff-venture The Cardiff venture doom-address Doom Has an Address river-lynleit river-operation female Lynleit ENFJ with strong Ni Once Lynleit is ashore, the feeling of hands holding her down may linger even while she tries to give orders. Her later complaint about the jacket can be petty and heartfelt: she liked it and could not save it. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-kyrien river-operation male Kyrien ISTP lean Keep Kyrien's answer literal and brief. He knows what he saw and chooses not to say it. His officer upbringing and watchfulness can appear in his attention to the search on the other bank. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-maren river-operation female Maren Type unknown Maren is a trained officer, not a weaker swimmer. The horror lies in losing ownership of her own movement when hands seize her legs. Once ashore, a short sensory statement is more credible than a theory: she knows what fingers felt like, but does not claim to know who they belonged to. Anger or embarrassment at having needed to be hauled over the wall may surface after the immediate shock. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-reiner river-operation male Reiner ISTJ with strong Si and Te Reiner's greater build makes him the practical anchor for Maren and Ivo, but the river prevents strength from solving the whole problem. He is likely to convert fear into tasks: secure the person, reach the wall, count the team, check the line. His later guilt would appear as stricter procedure and repeated equipment checks rather than a broad confession. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-felix river-operation male Felix ESFP with strong Se and Fi Remaining ashore should frustrate Felix because his most valued people descend without him. His role is still decisive. He keeps the cameras frozen, hears the failure before he can see it, abandons the van at the correct moment, and turns a communications fallback into a physical rescue line. entries.text: Character Capability Balance Editorial Ledger Questions and contradictions that keep character skills, talents, abilities, strengths, weaknesses, costs, and comparative graphs balanced across the cast. Character Capability Balance This is the living balance ledger for character skills, talents, abilities, strengths, and weaknesses. It exists to keep every character distinct, useful, and vulnerable when compared with the rest of the cast. The current six-axis graph is provisional. Axis names, definitions, and even the number of axes may change whenever the model stops distinguishing characters accurately. Exact scores are not canon merely because they appear precise. Balance standard Every exceptional strength needs a defined scope. A character should dominate particular problems, not every problem. Every major ability needs limits, costs, counterplay, failure conditions, or consequences. Every character needs at least one weakness that matters in scenes rather than only on a graph. Similar specialists must remain different in method. Felix reaches around a barrier, Reiner goes through it, and Kyrien survives by controlling the conditions around it. Capability must be placed in time. A late-story peak should not be presented as an opening-chapter baseline. Social, intellectual, physical, technical, and supernatural competence should not be collapsed into a single idea of power. Balance does not require equal strength. It requires meaningful tradeoffs, dependency on others, and credible ways to fail. Capability questions These questions define what each character can do, what they cannot do, and why another character remains necessary. Confidence measures how much of the answer is already established elsewhere on the site. Area Question Confidence --- --- --- Scale What does 0, 25, 50, 75, 90, and 100 mean on a comparative capability scale, and is the reference group ordinary people, trained professionals, Magi, or the named cast? 0% Axis model Should the current Magecraft axis be paired with a separate Anomalous Nature axis, especially when a non-Magus demiholumn such as Lester cannot be described accurately by practiced ability? 0% Axis model Should Fieldcraft be divided into technical systems, infiltration, survival, and physical operations so Felix, Kyrien, Tien, Heyk, and Reiner are not measured as if they share one discipline? 0% Axis model Should Combat distinguish force, technique, ranged capability, and survival under pressure, or is a single comparative combat axis still useful? 0% Axis model Should an ordinary non-human character such as Ash the cat use the operational six-axis graph, or receive a smaller behavior-oriented record that does not compare him with trained agents and Magi? 0% Timeline Should profiles display separate opening, crisis, and late-story capability states for characters whose competence changes substantially? 0% Helena Is Helena a Magus, what practical abilities support her takeover, and what weakness prevents political manipulation from making her self-sufficient? 0% Fionn What operational blind spots, physical limitations, magical costs, or personal dependencies make Fionn vulnerable despite his mastery? 0% Lester What can Lester's demiholumn nature actually do, what can it never do, what triggers it, and what cost or danger follows an impossible intervention? 0% Son Does Lynleit and Kyrien's son inherit the blue-flame lineage, another ability, or no Magus talent, and how would any inheritance remain balanced against both parents? 0% Lynleit and Kyrien Does the identity curse leave any lasting physical, magical, or psychological limitation after it fractures, or do all capability effects end with the terminal condition? 0% Lynleit Beyond passing MSF weapons certification, what level of firearms skill does Lynleit possess, and where does she remain dependent on Felix, Reiner, Kyrien, or another specialist? 0% Items & Artefacts What governs the leviathan-hide coat's autonomous forms, what counts as minor magical damage, can it refuse protection, and what prevents it from becoming a universal defence? 0% Inspector Leo Which investigative strengths belong specifically to Leo, and what does restricted clearance prevent him from accomplishing without Natalia, MSF, or Church access? 20% Natalia Which magical disciplines support Natalia's examinations, what can she not diagnose alone, and what cost or risk prevents broad scholarship from solving every edge case? 20% Myka Which Academy disciplines make Myka a strong Magus, which remain weak despite graduating at the top of her class, and what failure still follows her into MSF? 25% Tien What constraints, personal blind spots, or counters keep Tien's elite fieldcraft and combat from making Helena's concealed assassin an automatic solution? 25% Sherie Beyond charm and quick thinking, what can Sherie execute without Drake, and which strategic or operational tasks still require her teacher? 30% Drake Where does Drake's strategic mastery fail without Sherie's social execution, and how capable is he when a problem becomes physical or magical rather than political? 30% Heyk Which skills survive the park massacre, which are damaged by trauma, and how does becoming Drake and Sherie's field agent change his strengths over time? 30% Felix What technical access, equipment, preparation, and failure conditions limit Felix's hacking and communications work? 35% Reiner How strong and durable is Reiner in practical terms, and what kinds of distance, deception, technology, or magecraft neutralize his direct approach? 35% Father Mikhail Which Church techniques let Mikhail survive several Magi threats alone in Cardiff, what preparation or cost do they require, and which threat can bypass them? 35% Lynleit After the confirmed underwater blue flame and fear-triggered water walking, how long can she sustain either effect, what bodily cost follows them, and what limits keep those abilities from replacing her allies' skills? 45% Axis model Should Analysis split into procedural verification and generative inference so Yulia and Hiyu's opposite investigative strengths are visible instead of receiving nearly identical scores under one label? 40% Yulia and Hiyu Which concrete park tasks require Yulia's procedural rigor, which require Hiyu's improvisation, and where does each method fail without the other? 50% Kyrien Which consequential failure shows how Kyrien's need to win and punish unfair play can override his officer discipline, and what blind spot appears when he later directs MSF while Lynleit carries the Magiarchate? 60% Balance contradictions This table is limited to current profile claims or graph presentations that cannot yet be reconciled with the balance standard. A row is removed only after the resolution is reflected in the character profile and comparative graph. Area Contradiction Resolution --- --- --- Fionn Fionn reaches 98 in Analysis and Magecraft, while Fieldcraft is lower at 72. The graph still does not identify the particular blind spots and dependencies that allow rivals to isolate and eliminate him. 0% Lester Lester receives a Magecraft score of 91 even though his profile explicitly classifies demiholumn nature as inherent and not magecraft. 0% Father Mikhail Cardiff establishes Mikhail as a formidable counter-Magus field operative, but the six-axis graph collapses Church countermeasures into ordinary Fieldcraft and Combat while correctly showing no magecraft. 20% System-wide Exact graph scores still look more authoritative than the underlying canon permits, although profiles now label the assessment and values as provisional and link directly to this balance ledger. 30% Kyrien Kyrien's graph now preserves clear limits below Tien's fieldcraft and combat while identifying competitiveness as an exploitable weakness, but it still presents his later intelligence mastery as a timeless value rather than a developed state. 35% Character Archive

entries.text: Character Intimacy and Sexuality Reference · v1 Writer's Character Reference A writer-facing reference for each character's approach to closeness, desire, sexual initiative, and established, asymmetric, or potential sexual tension. Character Intimacy and Sexuality Reference A writer's reference to affection, attraction, initiative, and particular partners. Established events and working interpretations are distinguished below. The shared tension records attached to each profile track pairings as new scenes develop. How to read the profiles Established means confirmed by the author or present in the selected canon. Working interpretation means a possibility derived from current characterization, not an event or preference the story has established. Unresolved means there is not enough information to describe it. Doom Has an Address follows Version 3. Lynleit and Kyrien survive after an incomplete attempt at intimacy. Their first completed sexual encounter occurs later in Arc 1; its exact placement is unresolved. Lynleit Basis: Established relationship; later behavior partly interpreted Natural approach Lynleit notices other people's needs and often makes herself responsible for them. Her work comes first. She usually values openness, but talking about her own desire embarrasses her. With someone she trusts, she can be playful and enjoy drawing out a reaction. Sexual expression Her attempt with Kyrien in Doom Has an Address is irritable, awkward, and incomplete. After they recover, she repeatedly insists there is no reason to try again. The unread pages and her response to Natalia suggest otherwise. Natalia keeps the familiar examination routine and deliberate silences; Lynleit's increasingly emphatic denials prolong the subject she wants to close. Their later pattern makes Lynleit the more frequent initiator. She is more vocal than Kyrien and likes teasing his reserve. The precise staging of those later encounters remains subject to the author's review. With Kyrien She knows his failed assassination nearly harmed her. He never learns she was there. That withheld fact gives the interrogation a personal edge before there is any attraction. Card games during the river watches give them something to do together outside her orders. She asks for rematches, learns his held breath before a risk, and catches him watching her hands. He protects her water-walking secret. Their recovery in the park and the later hotel refuge remain non-sexual. He eventually stays when she can no longer compel him. When she asks what reward makes the danger worthwhile, he answers, "Because there's a battle to be fought." She cannot dismiss his persistence as obedience or explain it through a promise she made him. The curse brings an incomplete attempt at intimacy, then a recovery she will not explain. Their sexual relationship begins afterward and lasts long enough to acquire private jokes and ordinary habits. A later encounter takes place in her third-floor study-bedroom. Pregnancy follows near the Arc 2 transition, with its meaning left for the reader to recognize at the next arc's opening. Her later return revives their physical awareness, but Kyrien still does not know about their son. The consequences for renewed intimacy remain a separate question. Writing guardrail Let embarrassment occasionally make her unfair or difficult. Her competence does not require an explanation defending each awkward response. Kyrien Basis: Established relationship; later behavior partly interpreted Natural approach Kyrien is slow to trust and says little about what he feels. He notices discomfort, changes in routine, and what someone is trying to hide. Staying, making preparations, or keeping a secret can express his attachment. Sexual expression The incomplete attempt in Doom Has an Address leaves him puzzled. He sees a connection with their recovery but lacks Lynleit's explanation. In their later relationship he is quieter and initiates less often than she does. The working portrayal gives him sustained attention and practical habits afterward, such as bringing water or staying beside her. These are possibilities for scenes, not a required sequence. With Lynleit Their games provoke his need to win. Her ability to read him irritates him and draws his attention back to her. Her elegance and nerve also attract him. He does not explain his decision to stay as a romantic sacrifice. He wants the battle. The question of how much he is still trying to prove to his father remains open. When she refuses to discuss the attempted intimacy, he lets the subject rest without ceasing to wonder about it. Their later sexual relationship need not settle every disagreement or make him talkative. Writing guardrail Give his silence a context. He may be watching, withholding an answer, annoyed, or simply have nothing to say. Helena Basis: Established marriage; working intimate interpretation Natural approach Helena wants to be admitted into a partner's whole life. Fionn's secrecy makes her doubt what their marriage means to him. A possible private habit is testing how much attention she has without admitting that she needs reassurance. Sexual expression No specific behavior is established. The working interpretation makes her attentive to whether a partner is distracted or withholding something. With Fionn Their attraction and domestic closeness coexist with his refusal to share his deepest secrets. He believes he is protecting her. She feels excluded from her own marriage. Writing guardrail Show what Fionn withholds and what Helena does about it. The narrator need not decide the legitimacy of her grievance for the reader. Fionn Basis: Established marriage; working intimate interpretation Natural approach Fionn provides for and protects the people he loves. He also decides what they should be allowed to know. Warmth does not make that habit disappear. Sexual expression No specific behavior is established. A patient, measured approach fits his present characterization, but a scene is needed before it becomes a reliable pattern. With Helena He respects and desires Helena while withholding the hidden workings of MSF, the Magiarchy, and his succession arrangements. His belief that secrecy protects her does not resolve her resentment. Writing guardrail Include ordinary companionship where the story calls for it. Every private exchange need not become a demonstration of their failed trust. Yulia Basis: Established attraction arc; working sexual interpretation Natural approach Yulia accompanies Hiyu while complaining about the reasons for going. She checks details, remembers responsibilities, and keeps him from overlooking practical risks. Sexual expression No encounter is established. A quiet and initially cautious approach is plausible; it should be tested against actual scenes rather than treated as an automatic consequence of her reserve. With Hiyu They argue over the same evidence and remain close while trying to prove each other wrong. Yulia is likely to notice that proximity before Hiyu does. Her impatience can include attraction without making her objections false. The approved development direction gives her an earlier awareness of the attachment. Hiyu continues treating the exchange as an argument about the investigation. Writing guardrail Let her be genuinely annoyed. Irritation does not have to conceal desire every time. Hiyu Basis: Established attraction arc; working sexual interpretation Natural approach Hiyu keeps seeking the person whose criticism makes his ideas more interesting. He notices the intellectual need before he understands the personal one. Sexual expression No encounter is established. Curiosity and improvisation are possible extensions of his personality, not established sexual preferences. With Yulia He seeks her corrections while resisting them. One proposed recognition scene has him enjoy investigating alone at first, then keep turning toward the place where she should be. His obliviousness delays his understanding of her attention. It does not make every concern she raises invisible to him. Writing guardrail Give him reasons to listen that arise from the case as well as the relationship. Felix Basis: Established flirtation and asymmetric tension with Lynleit Natural approach Felix flirts, jokes, and watches the response. Serious feelings can be harder for him to state plainly than a playful advance. Sexual expression The working interpretation makes him communicative, playful, and comfortable initiating. His private behavior has not yet been established in a scene. With Lynleit and Sherie Lynleit deflects his advances while remaining his close friend. His attraction does not establish a matching desire on her side. Sherie can match his wit. Their similar habits allow them to keep flirting without saying anything definite. His attachment to Lynleit complicates Sherie's interest in him. Writing guardrail An unsuccessful joke, a change of subject, or a plain answer can distinguish his sincere attention from his usual performance. Reiner Basis: Established friendship; intimate life unresolved Natural approach Reiner shows care through consistency and preparation. A working interpretation gives him more ease with practical help than courtship. Sexual expression No specific behavior is established. Privacy and a deliberate pace are possibilities to explore. With a specific partner No partner is established. His long-standing friendship with Lynleit is protective. Writing guardrail His reserve leaves room for warmth. It does not prescribe how every private encounter must unfold. Sherie Basis: Established personality and flirtation; sexual behavior unresolved Natural approach Sherie enjoys attention and praise. Flirting is also part of her diplomatic skill, used so often that it can make a sincere approach difficult to distinguish from a practiced one. Sexual expression A playful, verbally expressive approach is plausible. Her actual preferences remain unwritten. With Felix and Kyrien Kyrien is a potential source of tension because he does not give her the reactions she expects. Repeated negotiation could turn that frustration personal. No relationship between them is established. Felix responds readily and can answer her teasing in kind. After learning that Lynleit has slept with Kyrien, Sherie challenges Lynleit's continuing sense of responsibility for Felix: "What exactly is this? Do you imagine every man is your permanent responsibility? Felix is not your wounded soldier. If you refuse to have him, I may very well take him myself, you shameless hussy!" Lynleit objects to her playing with him. Sherie's interest includes competition with Lynleit, but whether it becomes lasting affection for Felix remains unresolved. This exchange belongs after Lynleit and Kyrien's later completed encounter, not immediately after Doom Has an Address. Writing guardrail Allow a sincere request to sound less polished than her diplomatic speech. Drake Basis: Working interpretation; partner unresolved Natural approach Drake may try to help by removing a practical burden while missing the reassurance a person wanted. This follows his established difficulty with social situations, but no intimate scene confirms it yet. Sexual expression No specific behavior is established. Reserve and overthinking are possibilities, not a complete profile. With a specific partner No partner is established. His closest recorded relationships are his friendship with the Duke and his role as Sherie's uncle and teacher. Writing guardrail Awkward timing is more specific than treating him as generally unable to understand feelings. Heyk Basis: Survivor's history established; intimate life unresolved Natural approach The loss of his squad may affect how he responds to closeness. Withdrawal, protectiveness, or vigilance are possibilities to test in a particular scene. Sexual expression No specific behavior is established. There is not enough evidence to decide how his grief affects desire or private comfort. With a specific partner No partner is established. Writing guardrail Do not assign the same trauma response to every encounter. The person, timing, and circumstances matter. Natalia Basis: Established tension with Lester; sexual behavior unresolved Natural approach Natalia values solitude and independent thought. Her work makes her accustomed to asking intimate questions as an examiner. Being personally involved can make that familiar method less useful. Sexual expression No specific behavior is established. An observant and selective approach is a working interpretation. With Lester She examines his demiholumn condition and is attracted to him. He notices when her attention becomes personal and provokes her to act rather than continue observing. Their work keeps bringing them together. Neither the attraction nor an eventual encounter would answer all of her questions about his nature. Writing guardrail Let her be curious about something ordinary in him too. His anomalous nature need not account for all of her interest. Tien Basis: Occupational context established; intimate life unresolved Natural approach His work requires secrecy. Whether he carries the same habits into private relationships is not established. Sexual expression No specific behavior is recorded. With a specific partner No partner is established. Helena is his employer and protected principal. Writing guardrail Do not turn an assassin's professional methods into a ready-made sexual personality. Lester Basis: Established tension with Natalia; personal history unresolved Natural approach Lester seeks direct experience and enjoys provoking Natalia. His response to being examined is part of their friction. Sexual expression No specific behavior is established. His demiholumn nature alone cannot supply it. With Natalia He wants her attention as a man as well as an unusual case. Her analytical distance gives him something to provoke, while their shared work gives the attraction repeated contact. Writing guardrail His ordinary tastes, humor, and irritation should remain available alongside the mystery of his body. Inspector Leo Basis: Marriage established; private life unresolved Natural approach His patience as an investigator offers one possible starting point. The archive does not yet establish how he behaves with his spouse. Sexual expression No specific behavior is recorded. With a specific partner Leo is married. His spouse is not yet described. He has no established sexual tension with Natalia and remains outside the Magi world. Writing guardrail Establish the marriage through a scene before projecting his police habits onto it. Father Mikhail Basis: Clerical role established; private life unresolved Natural approach His history, personal attachments, and vows are not yet defined. Sexual expression No specific behavior is recorded. His blunt advice to Lynleit establishes how he speaks to her, not how he behaves with a partner. With a specific partner No partner is established. Writing guardrail Neither celibacy nor a hidden romance follows from the title Father. Myka Basis: Familial closeness established; romantic history unresolved Natural approach to closeness Myka confides in Natalia about studies and personal worries. Natalia checks on her and sometimes treats her like a daughter. With a specific partner No romantic partner or sexual profile is recorded. Archive-wide writing principles Preserve each character's work, loyalties, and immediate objective. Use recurring contact specific to the pair. Shared danger can intensify attraction but does not establish it by itself. Distinguish attention from attraction and attraction from a promised relationship. Let gestures, interruptions, and choices carry implications without narrating the conclusion again. A useful encounter may leave a disagreement, an unanswered question, or a changed habit. Keep interpretations separate from confirmed preferences. Revisit them when new scenes supply evidence. Established arc Mutual, slow to surface lynleit Lynleit Lynleit studies Kyrien first as a recruit whose failed attack nearly harmed her. Their card games make that scrutiny personal: she learns his tells and begins noticing his hands and breath. Later she attempts intimacy as a possible treatment for their shared curse, but remains interested after they survive without completing it. kyrien Kyrien Kyrien wants to beat Lynleit at cards and dislikes finding that she can read him. Her elegance and nerve also attract him. He stays because he wants the battle, then finds himself facing private questions that her orders cannot answer. After the attempted intimacy, she will not tell him why their curse disappeared. The interrogation, card games, protected secret, and voluntary decision to stay give this pairing different kinds of familiarity. In Doom Has an Address, an incomplete attempt at intimacy breaks the shared curse. Lynleit loses the excuse of treatment without losing her interest in Kyrien; he is left trying to understand what happened. Their sexual relationship begins later in Arc 1. Established asymmetry Felix overt, Lynleit deflecting lynleit Lynleit Felix's flirting belongs to a long friendship she refuses to reorganize around his advances. Her ease with him, combined with the repeated refusal, creates visible chemistry without requiring matching sexual intent. felix Felix Lynleit is one of the few people his charm cannot simply move into the response he wants. Familiar affection, physical ease, and repeated deflection keep his attraction active even when he respects the boundary she has made. The tension is easy for readers to recognize because it already has a social rhythm: he advances through jokes and flirtation, she ignores or redirects him, and neither abandons the closeness underneath the exchange. It does not need to become a relationship to remain real. Emerging arc Mutual, unequally conscious yulia Yulia Hiyu irritates her into sustained attention. She keeps arguing, correcting, and following because his ideas have already occupied more of her mind than she wants to admit. Suppressed attraction can sharpen both her impatience and her awareness of his physical presence. hiyu Hiyu Yulia is the critic whose resistance makes an idea worth pursuing. He becomes dependent on her attention before he understands that the dependence is personal, leaving him oblivious to tension that is already changing how he seeks her out. Their arguments repeatedly force proximity and attention. They lean over the same evidence, reach for the same document, and forget ordinary distance while trying to prove incompatible explanations. Yulia notices first and steps away; Hiyu continues the theory and wonders why she moved. Her anger becomes disproportionate when his recklessness makes the possibility of losing him real. Hiyu recognizes the bond through absence: an investigation without her corrections becomes less interesting, and he keeps turning toward the place where she should be. Yulia and Hiyu become intimate by learning to communicate through the noise they already create together. Strong potential Situational and confrontational kyrien Kyrien Sherie's charm is too deliberate to disarm him, but the precision behind it earns his attention. He is more likely to watch for the moment her performance fails than reward the performance itself. sherie Sherie Kyrien's refusal to be steered threatens a skill she has internalized as part of her identity. Each failed attempt to produce a reaction can make his eventual attention feel more valuable and personally dangerous. Sherie uses language and calibrated flirtation to control the rhythm of an exchange. Kyrien answers with silence, literalism, or no usable reaction at all. Repeated negotiation could turn her professional frustration into sexual tension without making them compatible or displacing Kyrien's eventual relationship with Lynleit. Established marriage Mutual, damaged by exclusion fionn Fionn Fionn's affection and desire for Helena are genuine. He separates bodily and domestic closeness from the secrets he believes he must carry alone, never understanding that this division changes what their intimacy means to her. helena Helena Helena experiences desire alongside the need to be admitted into Fionn's complete life. Physical familiarity can therefore intensify resentment: she can be close enough to know his body while remaining excluded from the truth governing him. Their sexual tension survives inside a real marriage because attraction and grievance occupy the same private space. The closer they become physically, the harder it is for Helena to accept that Fionn still decides which parts of himself she is permitted to know. Established tension Mutual, differently expressed natalia Natalia Lester is the living exception that Natalia cannot finish classifying. Her professional attention can become personal before she recognizes the change, especially when he interrupts an examination by noticing that she is watching him rather than the phenomenon around him. lester Lester Natalia's analytical distance gives Lester something unusually difficult to provoke. He enjoys forcing the reserved researcher into immediate experience, but the tension changes when he wants her attention to recognize the man rather than examine the demiholumn condition. Repeated cases bring Natalia's examination of Lester into conflict with his insistence on being treated as more than a case. He provokes her to act; she notices more than he expected. Their attraction does not answer her questions about his demiholumn nature. Emerging potential Mutual play, sincerity unresolved sherie Sherie Felix gives Sherie immediate wit, visible attention, and resistance that does not become hostility. She first tests him as play and competition, including whether his attention can be drawn away from Lynleit. The tension becomes personal when winning ceases to satisfy her and she begins wanting a response that is not produced by technique. felix Felix Sherie can match Felix's teasing without mistaking it for a complete confession. Her ability to see when he hides seriousness behind a joke gives him an opponent and possible partner who can enjoy the performance while still asking for something sincere. His unresolved feelings for Lynleit prevent Sherie from winning him by charm alone. Both use social ease as protection: Felix hides seriousness behind jokes, while Sherie hides vulnerability behind charm and diplomacy. Their chemistry is immediate, but similarity makes them capable of prolonged flirtation without honest movement. Sherie begins testing the friendship after learning that Lynleit has slept with Kyrien while still feeling responsible for Felix's affection. Her refusal to treat Felix as Lynleit's permanent responsibility creates a comic rivalry with Lynleit and a more serious test of whether Sherie wants Felix himself or only wants to win his attention. tien No current pairing contains enough personal exposure beyond professional dependency or operational rivalry. heyk No current pairing is supported. Shared danger and survivor's grief do not create sexual tension on their own. drake No current pairing has the repeated personal friction needed to move beyond abstract compatibility. reiner No current pairing is supported. His long-standing bond with Lynleit remains protective rather than romantic. inspector-leo Leo is married and remains outside the hidden Magi world. No sexual-tension pairing beyond his marriage is supported. father-mikhail No current pairing is supported. His vows, private history, and relationship to desire remain undefined. myka No current record. Character Archive

His private behavior has not yet been established in a scene. With Lynleit and Sherie Lynleit deflects his advances while remaining his close friend. His attraction does not establish a matching desire on her side. Sherie can match his wit. Their similar habits allow them to keep flirting without saying anything definite. His attachment to Lynleit complicates Sherie's interest in him. Writing guardrail An unsuccessful joke, a change of subject, or a plain answer can distinguish his sincere attention from his usual performance. Reiner Basis: Established friendship; intimate life unresolved Natural approach Reiner shows care through consistency and preparation. A working interpretation gives him more ease with practical help than courtship. Sexual expression No specific behavior is established. Privacy and a deliberate pace are possibilities to explore. With a specific partner No partner is established. His long-standing friendship with Lynleit is protective. Writing guardrail His reserve leaves room for warmth. It does not prescribe how every private encounter must unfold. Sherie Basis: Established personality and flirtation; sexual behavior unresolved Natural approach Sherie enjoys attention and praise. Flirting is also part of her diplomatic skill, used so often that it can make a sincere approach difficult to distinguish from a practiced one. Sexual expression A playful, verbally expressive approach is plausible. Her actual preferences remain unwritten. With Felix and Kyrien Kyrien is a potential source of tension because he does not give her the reactions she expects. Repeated negotiation could turn that frustration personal. No relationship between them is established. Felix responds readily and can answer her teasing in kind. After learning that Lynleit has slept with Kyrien, Sherie challenges Lynleit's continuing sense of responsibility for Felix: "What exactly is this? Do you imagine every man is your permanent responsibility? Felix is not your wounded soldier. If you refuse to have him, I may very well take him myself, you shameless hussy!" Lynleit objects to her playing with him. Sherie's interest includes competition with Lynleit, but whether it becomes lasting affection for Felix remains unresolved. This exchange belongs after Lynleit and Kyrien's later completed encounter, not immediately after Doom Has an Address. Writing guardrail Allow a sincere request to sound less polished than her diplomatic speech. Drake Basis: Working interpretation; partner unresolved Natural approach Drake may try to help by removing a practical burden while missing the reassurance a person wanted. This follows his established difficulty with social situations, but no intimate scene confirms it yet. Sexual expression No specific behavior is established. Reserve and overthinking are possibilities, not a complete profile. With a specific partner No partner is established. His closest recorded relationships are his friendship with the Duke and his role as Sherie's uncle and teacher. Writing guardrail Awkward timing is more specific than treating him as generally unable to understand feelings. Heyk Basis: Survivor's history established; intimate life unresolved Natural approach The loss of his squad may affect how he responds to closeness. Withdrawal, protectiveness, or vigilance are possibilities to test in a particular scene. Sexual expression No specific behavior is established. There is not enough evidence to decide how his grief affects desire or private comfort. With a specific partner No partner is established. Writing guardrail Do not assign the same trauma response to every encounter. The person, timing, and circumstances matter. Natalia Basis: Established tension with Lester; sexual behavior unresolved Natural approach Natalia values solitude and independent thought. Her work makes her accustomed to asking intimate questions as an examiner. Being personally involved can make that familiar method less useful. Sexual expression No specific behavior is established. An observant and selective approach is a working interpretation. With Lester She examines his demiholumn condition and is attracted to him. He notices when her attention becomes personal and provokes her to act rather than continue observing. Their work keeps bringing them together. Neither the attraction nor an eventual encounter would answer all of her questions about his nature. Writing guardrail Let her be curious about something ordinary in him too. His anomalous nature need not account for all of her interest. Tien Basis: Occupational context established; intimate life unresolved Natural approach His work requires secrecy. Whether he carries the same habits into private relationships is not established. Sexual expression No specific behavior is recorded. With a specific partner No partner is established. Helena is his employer and protected principal. Writing guardrail Do not turn an assassin's professional methods into a ready-made sexual personality. Lester Basis: Established tension with Natalia; personal history unresolved Natural approach Lester seeks direct experience and enjoys provoking Natalia. His response to being examined is part of their friction. Sexual expression No specific behavior is established. His demiholumn nature alone cannot supply it. With Natalia He wants her attention as a man as well as an unusual case. Her analytical distance gives him something to provoke, while their shared work gives the attraction repeated contact. Writing guardrail His ordinary tastes, humor, and irritation should remain available alongside the mystery of his body. Inspector Leo Basis: Marriage established; private life unresolved Natural approach His patience as an investigator offers one possible starting point. The archive does not yet establish how he behaves with his spouse. Sexual expression No specific behavior is recorded. With a specific partner Leo is married. His spouse is not yet described. He has no established sexual tension with Natalia and remains outside the Magi world. Writing guardrail Establish the marriage through a scene before projecting his police habits onto it. Father Mikhail Basis: Clerical role established; private life unresolved Natural approach His history, personal attachments, and vows are not yet defined. Sexual expression No specific behavior is recorded. His blunt advice to Lynleit establishes how he speaks to her, not how he behaves with a partner. With a specific partner No partner is established. Writing guardrail Neither celibacy nor a hidden romance follows from the title Father. Myka Basis: Familial closeness established; romantic history unresolved Natural approach to closeness Myka confides in Natalia about studies and personal worries. Natalia checks on her and sometimes treats her like a daughter. With a specific partner No romantic partner or sexual profile is recorded. Archive-wide writing principles Preserve each character's work, loyalties, and immediate objective. Use recurring contact specific to the pair. Shared danger can intensify attraction but does not establish it by itself. Distinguish attention from attraction and attraction from a promised relationship. Let gestures, interruptions, and choices carry implications without narrating the conclusion again. A useful encounter may leave a disagreement, an unanswered question, or a changed habit. Keep interpretations separate from confirmed preferences. Revisit them when new scenes supply evidence. Established arc Mutual, slow to surface lynleit Lynleit Lynleit studies Kyrien first as a recruit whose failed attack nearly harmed her. Their card games make that scrutiny personal: she learns his tells and begins noticing his hands and breath. Later she attempts intimacy as a possible treatment for their shared curse, but remains interested after they survive without completing it. kyrien Kyrien Kyrien wants to beat Lynleit at cards and dislikes finding that she can read him. Her elegance and nerve also attract him. He stays because he wants the battle, then finds himself facing private questions that her orders cannot answer. After the attempted intimacy, she will not tell him why their curse disappeared. The interrogation, card games, protected secret, and voluntary decision to stay give this pairing different kinds of familiarity. In Doom Has an Address, an incomplete attempt at intimacy breaks the shared curse. Lynleit loses the excuse of treatment without losing her interest in Kyrien; he is left trying to understand what happened. Their sexual relationship begins later in Arc 1. Established asymmetry Felix overt, Lynleit deflecting lynleit Lynleit Felix's flirting belongs to a long friendship she refuses to reorganize around his advances. Her ease with him, combined with the repeated refusal, creates visible chemistry without requiring matching sexual intent. felix Felix Lynleit is one of the few people his charm cannot simply move into the response he wants. Familiar affection, physical ease, and repeated deflection keep his attraction active even when he respects the boundary she has made. The tension is easy for readers to recognize because it already has a social rhythm: he advances through jokes and flirtation, she ignores or redirects him, and neither abandons the closeness underneath the exchange. It does not need to become a relationship to remain real. Emerging arc Mutual, unequally conscious yulia Yulia Hiyu irritates her into sustained attention. She keeps arguing, correcting, and following because his ideas have already occupied more of her mind than she wants to admit. Suppressed attraction can sharpen both her impatience and her awareness of his physical presence. hiyu Hiyu Yulia is the critic whose resistance makes an idea worth pursuing. He becomes dependent on her attention before he understands that the dependence is personal, leaving him oblivious to tension that is already changing how he seeks her out. Their arguments repeatedly force proximity and attention. They lean over the same evidence, reach for the same document, and forget ordinary distance while trying to prove incompatible explanations. Yulia notices first and steps away; Hiyu continues the theory and wonders why she moved. Her anger becomes disproportionate when his recklessness makes the possibility of losing him real. Hiyu recognizes the bond through absence: an investigation without her corrections becomes less interesting, and he keeps turning toward the place where she should be. Yulia and Hiyu become intimate by learning to communicate through the noise they already create together. Strong potential Situational and confrontational kyrien Kyrien Sherie's charm is too deliberate to disarm him, but the precision behind it earns his attention. He is more likely to watch for the moment her performance fails than reward the performance itself. sherie Sherie Kyrien's refusal to be steered threatens a skill she has internalized as part of her identity. Each failed attempt to produce a reaction can make his eventual attention feel more valuable and personally dangerous. Sherie uses language and calibrated flirtation to control the rhythm of an exchange. Kyrien answers with silence, literalism, or no usable reaction at all. Repeated negotiation could turn her professional frustration into sexual tension without making them compatible or displacing Kyrien's eventual relationship with Lynleit. Established marriage Mutual, damaged by exclusion fionn Fionn Fionn's affection and desire for Helena are genuine. He separates bodily and domestic closeness from the secrets he believes he must carry alone, never understanding that this division changes what their intimacy means to her. helena Helena Helena experiences desire alongside the need to be admitted into Fionn's complete life. Physical familiarity can therefore intensify resentment: she can be close enough to know his body while remaining excluded from the truth governing him. Their sexual tension survives inside a real marriage because attraction and grievance occupy the same private space. The closer they become physically, the harder it is for Helena to accept that Fionn still decides which parts of himself she is permitted to know. Established tension Mutual, differently expressed natalia Natalia Lester is the living exception that Natalia cannot finish classifying. Her professional attention can become personal before she recognizes the change, especially when he interrupts an examination by noticing that she is watching him rather than the phenomenon around him. lester Lester Natalia's analytical distance gives Lester something unusually difficult to provoke. He enjoys forcing the reserved researcher into immediate experience, but the tension changes when he wants her attention to recognize the man rather than examine the demiholumn condition. Repeated cases bring Natalia's examination of Lester into conflict with his insistence on being treated as more than a case. He provokes her to act; she notices more than he expected. Their attraction does not answer her questions about his demiholumn nature. Emerging potential Mutual play, sincerity unresolved sherie Sherie Felix gives Sherie immediate wit, visible attention, and resistance that does not become hostility. She first tests him as play and competition, including whether his attention can be drawn away from Lynleit. The tension becomes personal when winning ceases to satisfy her and she begins wanting a response that is not produced by technique. felix Felix Sherie can match Felix's teasing without mistaking it for a complete confession. Her ability to see when he hides seriousness behind a joke gives him an opponent and possible partner who can enjoy the performance while still asking for something sincere. His unresolved feelings for Lynleit prevent Sherie from winning him by charm alone. Both use social ease as protection: Felix hides seriousness behind jokes, while Sherie hides vulnerability behind charm and diplomacy. Their chemistry is immediate, but similarity makes them capable of prolonged flirtation without honest movement. Sherie begins testing the friendship after learning that Lynleit has slept with Kyrien while still feeling responsible for Felix's affection. Her refusal to treat Felix as Lynleit's permanent responsibility creates a comic rivalry with Lynleit and a more serious test of whether Sherie wants Felix himself or only wants to win his attention. tien No current pairing contains enough personal exposure beyond professional dependency or operational rivalry. heyk No current pairing is supported. Shared danger and survivor's grief do not create sexual tension on their own. drake No current pairing has the repeated personal friction needed to move beyond abstract compatibility. reiner No current pairing is supported. His long-standing bond with Lynleit remains protective rather than romantic. inspector-leo Leo is married and remains outside the hidden Magi world. No sexual-tension pairing beyond his marriage is supported. father-mikhail No current pairing is supported. His vows, private history, and relationship to desire remain undefined. myka No current record. Character Archive
